## Goal

Session handling and the log in / sign up screen, with `App` switching
between the auth screen and a signed-in shell.

## Plan

### Files to touch

- `frontend/src/auth/AuthContext.tsx`, `frontend/src/auth/AuthScreen.tsx`
- `frontend/src/App.tsx` (replace the placeholder)
- `frontend/src/test/fetchRouter.ts` (a stub-fetch helper later tickets reuse)
- tests: `AuthContext.test.tsx`, `AuthScreen.test.tsx`, `App.test.tsx` (replace the placeholder test)

### Steps

1. `AuthContext.tsx`: `type AuthStatus = "loading" | "signedOut" | "signedIn"`; `AuthProvider({children})` holds `status`, `user: User | null`, `token: string | null` (a ref read by `createApi(() => tokenRef.current)`, created once). On mount: `loadToken()`; none -> `signedOut`; else `api.me()` -> `signedIn`; an `ApiError` with code `unauthorized` -> `clearToken()` and `signedOut`; any other error -> `signedOut` keeping the token.
2. Context value `{status, user, token, api, login(username, password), register(username, displayName, password), logout()}`; `login`/`register` call the API, `saveToken`, set the user and `signedIn`, and rethrow for the screen; `logout` calls `api.logout()` ignoring errors, `clearToken()`, `signedOut`. `export function useAuth()` throws outside the provider.
3. `AuthScreen.tsx`: heading `Boards`; buttons `Log in` / `Sign up` (with `aria-pressed`); a form with labelled `Username`, `Display name` (sign up only), `Password` (`type="password"`); submit `Log in` or `Create account`, disabled while pending; `ApiError` -> its message in `<p role="alert">`, else `Something went wrong`.
4. `App.tsx`: `AuthProvider` around an inner component: `loading` -> `<p>Loading…</p>`; `signedOut` -> `AuthScreen`; `signedIn` -> `<header>` with `Signed in as <display_name>` and a `Log out` button, and a `<main>` placeholder that ticket 005 replaces with the routes.
5. `test/fetchRouter.ts`: `export function stubFetch(routes: Record<string, (req: {body: unknown; headers: Headers}) => {status: number; body?: unknown} | Promise<...>>)` keyed `"METHOD /api/path"`, installing `vi.stubGlobal("fetch", ...)` and recording calls; an unrouted call fails the test with a clear message.
6. Run `make verify` and make it pass.

### Tests to add

- `AuthContext.test.tsx`: no token -> signedOut without fetch; stored token + me 200 -> signedIn; me 401 `unauthorized` -> token cleared; me 500 -> signedOut with the token kept; logout clears the token even when the request fails.
- `AuthScreen.test.tsx`: log in posts the values and enters the app; sign up posts `display_name`; 401 `invalid_credentials` shows `invalid username or password`; 409 shows its message; button disabled while a never-resolving fetch is pending; mode switch shows/hides `Display name`.
- `App.test.tsx`: signed out shows the `Boards` heading and the form; signed in shows `Signed in as Alice`; `Log out` returns to the form. Clear `localStorage` in `beforeEach`.
